image_source.detail: instashop.com/robots.txt disallows /product/* and /search/* for all crawlers, and the store page returns HTTP 403 to non-browser requests. Per the task's own rule, automated acquisition was stopped rather than bypassed.
image_source.what_is_needed: an authorised export of the InstaShop product images (the pharmacy can pull these from their InstaShop merchant dashboard), OR a folder of photos keyed by product code, OR written permission + API access from InstaShop. Once available, drop the files into public/images/products/<code>.jpg and list their codes in src/data/products.js (CODES_WITH_IMAGE).

note: Every product currently renders a clean fallback (category illustration, or an accurate shade swatch for hair colour) — no product is shown a wrong image. The list below is only rows with a data problem in the source sheet that a human should look at.
